The hard-coded ar/en fallback text was removed (the policy must come from the legal service); with the service down the screen shows the failure state with retry, also before sign-in. Owner to confirm, or to supply a bundled approved text.

The about screen (Batch 12 AboutView) opens the published policy documents from /legal/policies inside the app and does not link to the signed-out /terms and /privacy screens; both read the same legal service.
